## Standing operator rules
Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module. Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya. Keep commits small. Run the “Python library release 2.8.0” steps separately, in between other work: (1) `git status --porcelain && python -m pytest -q`; (2) `hatch version 2.8.0`; (3) `python scripts/build_release_notes.py --version 2.8.0 --write`; (4) `git add pyproject.toml CHANGELOG.md RELEASE_NOTES_2.8.0.md && git commit -m 'release: 2.8.0'`; (5) `git tag -a v2.8.0 -m 'acme-utils 2.8.0' && git push origin v2.8.0`; (6) `rm -rf build dist && python -m build`; (7) `python -m twine check dist/acme_utils-2.8.0*`; (8) `python -m twine upload dist/acme_utils-2.8.0*`; (9) `gh release create v2.8.0 --repo acme/acme-utils --title 'acme-utils 2.8.0' --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES_2.8.0.md`. Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Fix dunning reminders to paid customers; router split paused. DST recurrence work was recent supporting work.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorator duplicated emails. Function-based `declarative_base()`, deprecated `Query.get()`, engine `echo=True`, and wildcard model imports were removed.

## Plan and progress
Release 1–3 done; 4–9 pending. Next: `git add pyproject.toml CHANGELOG.md RELEASE_NOTES_2.8.0.md && git commit -m 'release: 2.8.0'`. Dunning: pending `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.

## Recent work
Fixed recurrence DST handling and added midnight/UTC regression coverage. Scheduler plus billing tests: 31 passed. Full logging suite previously had one expected-field failure, then its test was fixed.
